profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | PhD Researcher in Interactive ML & Visualization | Microsoft Certified Fabric Analytics Engineer | Data Platform & Digital Transformation Leader
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer with over 10 years of experience in full-stack development of enterprise systems. I’ve led complex technical initiatives—from designing and developing scalable high performant web applications to implementing cloud-based data infrastructure. 

Most recently, I served as the product owner for the data lake workstream of DePaul University's Digital Transformation initiative.  In this role, I coordinated across technical and business teams to implement a university-wide data lake platform from the ground up.

I’m also pursuing a PhD focused on interactive machine learning and data visualization. My research explores how users interact with and steer machine learning systems through visual interfaces bridging the gap between complex algorithms and human intuition. My most recent work explores how data visualization can support multi-criteria decision making.

Current Interests: Interactive ML application, Explainable AI, Visual Analytics, Visualization for Decision Making and Human-Centered AI

Always open to collaborations, research discussions, or roles where engineering meets user experience and data. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Owner - Data Lake
positions.description:
•	Led the data lake workstream of DePaul’s university-wide Digital Transformation initiative, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, facilitating project activities, monitoring progress, and approving deliverables to implement an Azure Data Lake based enterprise data platform.
•	Developed the proof-of-concept for DePaul’s data lake initiative, evaluating a prospective cloud data platform for feasibility and institutional fit.
•	Evaluated and recommended technologies for website migration based on scalability, maintainability, and fit with requirements.
•	Support the development and rollout of updated Sitecore websites and an internal portal as part of the university’s modernization strategy.
•	Collaborate on the migration and transformation of legacy websites, ensuring compliance with modern architecture, accessibility, and usability standards.
•	Develop and maintain website components with a focus on functionality, accessibility, and performance.
•	Mentor junior developers, shared best practices, and provided hands-on support for troubleshooting and development tasks.

positions.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained DePaul websites, applications using SharePoint, C#, and JavaScript.
•	Served as the subject matter expert (SME) for website components, providing technical guidance and maintenance support.
•	Collaborated on website upgrades, troubleshooting issues, updating webparts and libraries for a smooth transition with minimal disruption to end users.
•	Trained new SharePoint editors on platform usage, content management workflows, and best practices.
•	Identified performance bottlenecks and implemented optimizations to improve page load speed and user experience.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: •	Developed machine learning library to simplify creation of interactive ML application with an interactive front-end steering machine learning algorithms in the backend using Python and JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Developer (Student Worker)
positions.description: •	Developed and maintained DePaul websites using SharePoint, C#, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed, and tested a Java-based prototype for a buying algorithm aimed at optimizing purchase quantities and placement decisions across Amazon inventory lines.
•	Unified logic previously implemented by multiple teams into a cohesive system.
•	Engineered the prototype to scale efficiently and handle input volumes in the millions, ensuring performance and reliability under high data loads.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed user interfaces, business logic, and service agents for the American Express Servicing Portal, integrating with web services for seamless functionality.
•	Tested functionality and collaborated with QA and interfacing teams to test components and validate end-to-end system behavior.
•	Designed and implemented database structures—including tables, stored procedures, triggers, and scheduled jobs—in Microsoft SQL Server.
•	Provided post-implementation maintenance and enhancement support.
•	Spearheaded a self-initiated effort to build a C# application in collaboration with the team, automating data collection workflows and enhancing process efficiency

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered to teach coding to secondary and middle school students of Chicago Public Schools.
Contributed expert insights and foresight on emerging trends in data and analytics in higher education for the 2025 Horizon Report.

projects.title: Unique Name Generator
projects.description: Developed an intelligent agent in Java that can generate unique names using Markovs model.
